translatorNotes: Register: informal tú, consistent with Phase 1.

'enrollment' -> 'matrícula'; 'admissions' -> 'admisiones'; 'enquiry' -> 'consulta'; 'family/families' -> 'familia(s)'; 'counselor' -> 'orientador'; 'campus tour' -> 'visita al campus'; 'shortlist' -> 'preseleccionar/preselección'; 'open day' -> 'jornada de puertas abiertas'; 'term' -> 'curso'/'fechas del curso'.

'fees' -> 'precios' (chose 'precios' over 'tasas'/'cuotas' for broad appeal incl. private schools/course creators; a reviewer targeting universities may prefer 'tasas'). 'tuition' folded into 'precios'. FLAG.
'safeguarding' -> 'protección del menor' (UK-origin term; standard ES equivalent). 'special needs' -> 'necesidades especiales'.
'tutoring centers' -> 'centros de refuerzo'; 'course creators' -> 'creadores de cursos'; 'language schools' -> 'escuelas de idiomas'; 'trial lessons' -> 'clases de prueba'; 'LMS' kept.
Brand names (WhatsApp Business, Twilio, Calendly, n8n, Make, Google Workspace) unchanged.
Prices/figures unchanged, currency named: '$1,000 and $5,000' -> '1.000 y 5.000 dólares'; '$50 to $300' -> '50 a 300 dólares'.
Case study reuses the real-estate brokerage speed-to-lead story (source does too); kept faithful.
Blog 'related reading' links point to English blog posts (Phase 3 not started); anchor text translated. Nav/footer service + industry links point to /es.
